text:
Marta Gomez: Heads-up — Harrier-XL v1 rollout scheduled Tue 09:00 PT. Benchmarks vs current prod models show ~2.7-3x token/sec per request for typical sequences. We need a quick capacity + networking impact projection for eu-west (primary canary) and us-west.

Ryan Patel: Do we have a baseline tokens/sec today and any per-customer splits? Also want GPU-hour estimate.

Sasha Li: Baseline (prod aggregate) ~= 40,000 tokens/sec. Quick back-of-envelope: expecting ~2.8x uplift from Harrier-XL -> ~112,000 tokens/sec aggregate. See calc below.
```
# rough calc (very rough)
baseline_tps = 40_000
multiplier = 2.8
expected_tps = baseline_tps * multiplier  # 112_000
tokens_per_gpu = 6_000  # measured on similar model/quant profile in staging
required_gpus = ceil(expected_tps / tokens_per_gpu)  # ~19
buffer = 0.15
reserve_gpus = ceil(required_gpus * (1 + buffer))  # 22
gpu_hours_day = reserve_gpus * 24  # 528
cost_per_gpu_hour = $3.20  # cloud list / reserved blended
daily_est_cost = gpu_hours_day * cost_per_gpu_hour  # ~$1.7k
```

Jun Park: Network note for eu-west: if we assume average response payloads are ~400 tokens (worst-case longer outputs), keep in mind egress and pod NIC saturation. With 112k tps and skewed long responses we could spike per-pod egress near 8-10 Gbps at 95th if we don't shard traffic. Need to confirm average token byte size and multiplexing overhead.

capacity-bot: recommendation generated: reserve 22 A100-equivalent GPUs in eu-west for canary (24h), with a dedicated routing pool + fallback to smaller quantized variant.

Sasha Li: Additional notes:
- If we enable KV/prefix caching for common prompts we could cut effective tps by ~12-18% for search-heavy customers.
- Batching: increase target batch window to 25-35ms during off-peak to improve tokens_per_gpu.
- Canary plan: start with 3% traffic -> validate latency P95 and top-k prompt hit rates, then ramp 10%/30%/100% with monitoring gates.

Marta Gomez: Proposed action items: 1) Pre-warm 22 GPUs in eu-west and 8 in us-west for initial canary; 2) Add network health checks and set pod egress cap alarms; 3) Configure autoscaler min to keep reserve during deploy; 4) Create cost estimate + approval ticket. Who owns?

ops-bot: pre-warm scheduled: 2026-03-24T03:00:00Z (eu-west). Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/harrier-xl-canary (internal link). Autoscaler update: min_replicas will be set to match reserved GPU pool.

Ryan Patel: I'll take ownership of the cost approval ticket and canary ramp plan. Will add quota requests for eu-west by EOD.

Jun Park: I'll run a targeted network soak: `kubectl run net-soak --image=network-test --replicas=6 -n infra-test` against the reserved pool and pull detailed NIC metrics (TX/RX, errors, queue drops). Will post results by 18:00 PT.

Marta Gomez: Perfect — please add short checklist to the runbook (pre-warm confirm, soak results, pcs p95 guardrails, rollback threshold). I'll coordinate with product for rollout gating.

Ryan Patel: One more ask — add fallback route to quantized harrier-lite in the routing policy if latency or GPU pressure > 80% for 5m.

Sasha Li: Agreed. I'll add the policy snippet and traffic weight toggles to the deployment PR.

Marta Gomez: Thanks all. We're on a tight window so let's keep updates in-thread. :rocket:
